description.value: Olympia Cycle and Ski is Vernon's full-service bike and ski shop, billing itself as the North Okanagan's go-to destination for cycling and snow sports. The shop stocks a wide range of road, mountain, commuter, and electric bikes from brands including Santa Cruz, Specialized, Giant, CUBE, and Liv, alongside a comprehensive parts and accessories inventory. Touring cyclists will find a dedicated service and repair department, bike rentals, and community ride programs including the Sprockids youth initiative and Tuesday group rides.
